name: Gen Ira C. Eaker Award (miniature medal body)
size_basis: estimated: the body measured in the Vanguard product photograph against the suspension ribbon's width, 174 px taken as 0.6875 in (the miniature suspension ribbon, 11/16 in, CAPR 39-1 11.3 as compose.js MINI_DRAPE): body 0.7349 x 0.8693 in in the photograph. Height follows the body's own aspect. The width is the existing CAP asset's (0.625 in, assets/medals, kept as the brief asks; the photo measures 0.7349 in). The drawing keeps the width and the box; it is built from the photograph's own measured proportions (body width 188.9 px = 0.625 in).
ribbon_attach_note: ribbon_attach is the top centre of the suspension ring (or of the bail where the box cuts the ring away), on the body axis: the body is upright, the photograph's hang angle (-1.2 deg) is removed; compose.js hangs it at the drape's V point

dimensions.ribbon_note: medal body only; the ribbon asset supplies the stripes and devices (ribbon_ref as the previous asset)

match_note: CAP body: the existing asset id and width of assets/medals/medal-eaker-award-miniature; ribbon_ref as that asset

ribbon_ref.note: medal body only; the ribbon asset supplies the stripes and devices. ribbon_attach is the top of the suspension ring.

frame.note: body width 0.625 in (the spec width); every length below is inches in the medal frame (origin = body centre, +y down, upright)

measured.hang_angle_note: angle (clockwise, degrees) at which the photographed medal hangs, from the bail axis; measured, removed: the shipped body is upright and ribbon_attach is the top centre of the ring (or of the bail where the box cuts the ring)

lettering.letter_positions: angle and radial extent of each letter, measured from the unwrapped annulus (generator, text.top / text.bottom)

gates.silhouette_iou: >= 0.95 (shipped upright miniature vs the photograph mask resampled into the same upright box)
gates.landmarks: every named feature centroid within 0.02 in of the reference
gates.edge_recall: lit-metal outline recall >= 0.80 within 0.012 in (0.006 in reported)
gates.ink_coverage: lit-metal area of mine / reference between 0.85 and 1.15 (body and named zones): letters and emblem strokes as solid as the reference
gates.ribbon_attach: top centre of the ring (or of the bail where the box cuts the ring) at the box top, x on the body axis

not_measurable: the engraved letters are hatched and low-contrast in the photograph: letter angles are read by eye on the contrast-stretched polar image (about +-1 to 2 deg, +-0.01 in) and the light-class cannot separate them from the lettering band background; the bottom words are IRA C. EAKER with word gaps after IRA and after C. (A to C gap about 7.5 deg against about 3 to 4.5 deg inside words); all letters of the bottom line are seen except the second E, which is placed between K and the last R by the letter pitch of the visible ones

the two ornaments at the ends of the words (left about -90 deg, right about +91 deg) are modelled as two lozenge outlines touching at their side vertices (radial pair, about 0.054 x 0.038 in): identified at 9x, but the stroke (about 0.0036 in) and the exact lozenge proportions are at the resolution limit of the photograph

the engraving grain: each globe cell carries fine vertical hatching and the left half of the globe is darker than the right (lighting), neither is drawn (flat tones); this, the hatching and the photograph resolution limit the light-class match of the globe to about 0.4 IoU (precision 0.63, recall 0.50): the grid rows and columns are placed at the fitted pitch but single cells are lit unevenly in the photograph
the torch flame shows internal strokes that are not resolved and is drawn as one silver teardrop (the flame pixels are a warm grey, median #61564d)
the suspension: the ring is mostly behind the ribbon and the bail leans against the die axis in the photograph, so the ring centre and radius are estimated from its visible arcs

the grid pitch is near the photograph's resolution (cell about 7 photograph pixels): the pitches and the centre are fitted by maximising groove darkness over the visible globe (and checked by light-class IoU), not read line by line
fidelity.note: Redrawn as clean parametric vector (LIVE13-ART 26, batch B): every element is modelled as the object it is (letters, stars, wreath leaves, banner, aircraft ...) with its proportions measured from the photograph and placed by measurement; flat tones with a lit and a shadow edge; upright. Replaces the traced body (LIVE13-ART 20).

fit_score.note: IoU of the shipped upright miniature against the photograph mask in the same box (lib-b.js)

notes: Designed miniature medal body (LIVE13-ART 26, batch B), upright. Measured from ira-c-eaker.jpeg (reference only, never shipped). Hang angle -1.2 deg of the photograph removed. The torch handle (cup and stem) is drawn in the colour measured from the photograph: base #654120 is the median RGB of its pixels, lit #735537 and shadow #4d3317 the 75-90 % and 10-25 % luminance groups; the rim lip, the silver edge along the stem and the flame stay silver as in the photograph. The rest of the medal is silver.
